From the source, this section takes the order of ideas:
the cost of Newton's method, the secant condition, and the BFGS and limited-memory BFGS updates.
The source states the updates as solutions of nearest-matrix problems without proof;
here the BFGS update is written out.
The Davidon-Fletcher-Powell and rank-1 updates, the nearest-matrix derivation, the history and the Julia code are not part of this section.

:::
